decisions.reason: The connector-role clarification does not change the established four-board topology or board inventory.
The LEDs remain powered by 5V from the power board; naming and assigning roles to the interboard power connectors does not change the LED supply or logic requirements.
The source clarifies electrical connector references and direction, not connector orientation, placement, mounting-hole clearance, or physical accessibility.
The source does not alter power-board dimensions, installation orientation, USB-C placement, mounting holes, or enclosure fit.
Clarifying that J_PWR_PWR carries 5V and 3V3 from the power board does not change the auxiliary LDO, source OR-ing, or standalone activation condition when the power board is absent.
The source concerns the separate J_PWR_PWR and J_SENSOR_PWR power connectors; the USB data route remains on J_PWR_SIGNAL and is unchanged.
The interboard power-connector roles do not alter the charge-status display, J_LED_CHG interface, resistor values, or component population requirements.
The source confirms interboard distribution of 3V3 but does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, regulation, or its existing normal-operation load role.
J_PWR_PWR and J_SENSOR_PWR are power-distribution connectors and do not affect the panel-control connector inventory, signals, or button-placement policy.
The source addresses power-connector direction and rails, not I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, bus speed, or signal topology.
Passing 5V through J_SENSOR_PWR is consistent with the existing sensor-power role and does not change the boost converter, enable control, GPIO, current rating, or powered-load policy.
The interboard 5V and 3V3 connector clarification does not affect the battery NTC terminal, J_BAT connection, or AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior.
